description:
PolicyBazaar, Insurance Agent या Direct? Health Insurance कहाँ से खरीदें? Complete Guide
Health Insurance: Agent vs Broker vs Direct vs Advisory - Which One Should YOU Choose?
I Bought Health Insurance from the WRONG Place - Here Are the 4 RIGHT Ways


Here's what nobody tells you - WHERE you buy your health insurance matters just as much as WHICH policy you buy. But everyone obsesses over "Star Health better hai ya Care Health?" while ignoring the bigger question: should you buy from PolicyBazaar, a traditional insurance agent, directly from the company website, or through new advisory platforms like Ditto?
In this complete guide, I'm breaking down all 4 ways to buy health insurance in India - with REAL pros and cons that actually matter when you're filing a claim at 2 AM.
🔴 What You'll Learn:
→ Why buying directly online might save you ₹5,000 but cost you ₹2 lakhs during claims
→ The truth about PolicyBazaar and insurance brokers - do they really give unbiased advice?
→ When traditional insurance agents are actually worth the extra premium
→ Should you pay a fee for advisory platforms like Ditto Insurance?
→ Real stories of claim rejections and approvals based on WHERE people bought from

💡 Perfect for you if:
You're planning to buy health insurance for yourself or family
You're confused between agent vs broker vs direct purchase
You want to understand cashless hospitalization and claim settlement process
Your parents need mediclaim and you don't know the best source
You've heard about PolicyBazaar but not sure if it's trustworthy

This is Video 1 of my 5-part health insurance series where I expose everything about buying health insurance in India. Subscribe so you don't miss the next videos!

Common queries that brought you here:
Health insurance kaise kharide
PolicyBazaar vs insurance agent
should I buy health insurance online
best health insurance companies in India
health insurance claim rejection reasons
mediclaim policy comparison
family floater vs individual health insurance
cashless hospitalization kaise kare
Ditto insurance review
health insurance for parents

Have you already bought health insurance? Comment below and tell me which source you used - I'm genuinely curious about your experience!
